name: Love, Pumpkin, and Other Complications
source:
Who said Valentine's Day was the most romantic time of the year ? Play as Emily, a young American girl who just moved to France. Living overseas can get lonely, but could tonight's Halloween party change it all ?

[From [url=https://quentinm.itch.io/lovepumpkincomplications]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
谁说情人节是一年中最浪漫的时刻？扮演艾米丽，一个刚搬到法国的年轻美国女孩。生活在海外可能会感到孤独，但今晚的万圣节派对能改变这一切吗？

[来自[url=https://quentinm.itch.io/lovepumpkincomplications]itch.io[/url]]
